measurementMethod: Boot: wall time from launch to Done, plus ModernFix total load and datapack load lines. Idle: spark tps/health after the stated idle seconds on a fresh world with no players. Worldgen: forceload of a 16x16-chunk square in 16 batches of 4x4, timed to each confirmation; cpuSeconds is the JVM process CPU time over the probe. The workstation was shared with other workers; the system CPU in each health line shows the load. Pairs base4/after4/after4-noRS/after4-noLT ran back to back.
